Name: Matty's Talkohlooeys' Homebrew Edits
Author: MattytheMouse
Description:
I play Stardew Valley with a lot of mods. [i]A lot of mods.[/i] Sometimes, they don't quite fit in with any sense of artistic cohesion.. Particularly character portraits, since I mainly use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269?tab=files] talkohlooeys' portrait mod[/url]. So what do I do when I install a modded character sprite, or an entirely new character all together...? I cannibalize[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269?tab=files] talkohlooeys' portrait mod[/url] to cobble something together that makes things fit a little better!

Here are some of my edits, uploaded with permission from talkohlooey, so as to preserve them online, share them with, and maybe inspire others!

[/list][/center]

Installation is easy: simply go into the necessary folder, create backups of the existing portraits if needed, and overwrite the portraits with the new ones!

Bear in mind: these portraits were created by mixing and matching elements from talkohlooey's own artwork, with only a few newly drawn elements. Some characters [i]might[/i] look a little samey under some circumstances.

If any mod authors wish that I not mention their work in this upload, simply say so, and I shall take it down! With that said, hope everybody enjoys! ♥
